item.title: Essential Modern Array Methods
item.description: Back in my early programming days, whenever I needed to filter a list or transform items, I’d immediately write an index loop: for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) { ... } It works, sure. But it’s verbose, full of mutable state, and easy to introduce accidental off-by-one bugs. :') Modern JavaScript treats arrays as first-class citizens with built-in functional transformation methods. Here are the big four you will use almost every single day.
